title: Anna Paulina Luna on Joe Rogan: read the Book of Enoch for UAP origins

tellings.quote: Okay, so if you read it, it talks about the fall of angels, um, thus creating really the precursor of civilization that led to the first flood.

plain: A US congresswoman named Anna Paulina Luna told Joe Rogan, host of a popular interview podcast, that anyone curious where unidentified flying objects come from should read the Book of Enoch, an ancient religious text, here in a translation by the scholar R. H. Charles. In her words, the book "talks about the fall of angels," which created "the precursor of civilization that led to the first flood," and her remarks come up on an episode with the researcher Tim Alberino as a hint that these beings may be very old.
